visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Rows Are Not Reversed
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Rotating clockwise should give 7 4 1 as the first row, but the program prints 1 4 7, which is only the transpose.

solution.explanation: Transposing mirrors the matrix over its diagonal, which is a reflection. Reversing each row afterwards turns that reflection into a clockwise rotation. Without the second step the matrix is only transposed.
